prompt: An almost empty paved street runs beneath an elevated rail line in a high-rise district at night, a few cars waiting at the kerb with their headlights on. The camera glides forward at walking height along the brick pavement. Teal strip lights under the viaduct and amber street lamps tint the glass towers. Quiet and cinematic, teal-and-orange grade.
title: Viaduct Street At Night

prompt: A single thin line of white foam slides up a flat sandy shore while the grey-green sea behind it lies almost still, marked only by faint ripples. The camera looks straight down from high above and drifts slowly sideways along the waterline. Soft overcast daylight flattens the colours to muted olive and silver. Minimal, calm, aerial footage.
title: Calm Shoreline From Above

prompt: The sun lifts over a far ridge and spreads warm light across rolling hills, dark stands of pine and dry golden meadows dotted with single trees. The drone rises gently and pushes forward over the grassland. Low orange sun on the right, pink and grey cloud above, long soft shadows. Peaceful, wide, natural landscape footage.
title: Sunrise Over Pine Hills

prompt: Ragged white cloud drifts across a steep mountainside covered in dense conifers, curling into the gullies and thinning as it climbs. Framed vertically, the camera hovers high above the treetops and tilts slowly up the slope towards the pale sky. Diffuse grey daylight, deep greens against soft white. Moody and atmospheric, documentary style.
title: Cloud On The Slope

prompt: A barista tips a steel gooseneck kettle and pours a slow circle of hot water into a paper filter seated in a deep red ceramic dripper, steam rising as the coffee grounds bloom. Locked-off close-up at counter height with a very shallow depth of field. Bright window light from the side, white worktop glowing. Clean, warm, slow-motion product look.
title: Pour-Over In Red

prompt: Heavy raindrops cling to a window and run down in jagged trails, while the dark shapes of tall fir trees sit out of focus behind the glass. The camera stays fixed and close, focus held on the droplets. Flat white overcast light turns the scene nearly monochrome, black branches on a blown-out sky. Still, melancholy, high-key macro footage.
title: Rain On The Pane

prompt: A line of footprints crosses the smooth flank of a large red-brown sand dune as wind lifts fine grains off the crest. The camera makes a slow, level pan across the dune in a wide letterbox frame. Dusk light fades behind streaked blue and peach cloud, the sand turning rust and shadow. Spare, silent, cinematic desert mood.
title: Footprints Across The Dune

prompt: Tall curtains of violet and green aurora ripple above a country road, with a lone fir tree and a low tree line standing in black silhouette. Vertical frame, camera locked off on a tripod and shot as a time-lapse so the light pulses and shifts. Stars show through a deep blue sky, the ground almost black. Dreamlike night-sky footage.
title: Violet Aurora Road

prompt: A street cook in a bright red apron chops a heap of crisp fried meat on a steel tray with a broad knife, scraping and turning the pieces between strokes. Vertical close-up from the customer's side of the stall, handheld and steady, the cook's face out of frame. Daylight from the open front, greens blurred behind. Lively documentary food footage.
title: Street Stall Chopping

prompt: A lean dog trots along a seafront promenade beside a white metal railing, head low, crossing the frame from right to left. The camera stands back and pans gently to follow. A hazy sun hangs low over a flat silver sea, the sky washed pale gold and the tarmac in cool shadow. Unhurried early-morning mood, natural and soft.
title: Dog On The Promenade

prompt: Small dark fish pick their way over a mound of pale branching coral in shallow tropical water, the rippling surface visible just overhead. Vertical frame, the camera drifts forward at a diver's pace and tilts slightly down towards the reef. Sunlight breaks through the surface in shifting patches of turquoise. Clear, bright underwater footage.
title: Shallow Reef Dive

prompt: Long trails of golden sparks fall slowly through a black night sky after a firework has burst, each streak crackling and fading as it drops. The camera is locked off and looks up, the frame filled only with darkness and falling light. The embers are the sole light source, warm orange on pure black. Minimal, slow-motion celebration footage.
title: Falling Gold Sparks

prompt: Snowflakes fall steadily past a tangle of bare winter branches, the trees leaning in from both sides of the frame. The camera holds still and looks slightly upward, focus set close so the branches stay soft. A white overcast sky gives flat, even light with no shadows. Quiet, pale, almost black-and-white winter footage.
title: Bare Branches In Snow

prompt: A narrow waterfall threads down a rock face almost hidden by thick jungle growth, broad banana leaves and ferns swaying in the spray. Vertical frame, the camera pushes in slowly through the foliage towards the water. Dim, filtered light under the canopy, saturated dark greens. Lush, humid, nature-documentary feel.
title: Hidden Jungle Cascade

prompt: Four friends in winter jackets walk side by side along a wide pebble beach towards the camera, talking and leaning into one another. A long lens holds them in a locked-off wide shot with the flat sea filling the background. Pale pink dusk light, no hard shadows, cool grey stones. Gentle, candid, end-of-day footage.
title: Friends On Pebble Beach

prompt: Traffic and trains streak past the foot of a cluster of glass office towers as evening comes on, windows lighting up one by one. Time-lapse from a fixed high vantage point, the frame perfectly still while everything below moves. Low sun rakes across the lower buildings and leaves the towers in blue shade. Crisp, modern, urban time-lapse.
title: Skyline Rush Hour

prompt: A chestnut horse trots along a wooden paddock fence towards the camera, mane lifting and breath showing in the cold air. The camera waits at fence height and holds as the horse approaches, bare trees and a white farm building behind. Thin winter daylight, pale sky, frosted grass. Honest rural footage in slow motion.
title: Chestnut At The Fence

prompt: A lone figure with an umbrella stands on a rain-soaked city street at night, then steps out across the road as cars pass. The camera stays wide and locked off at street level. Red, pink and yellow neon from the shopfronts smears across the wet tarmac in long reflections. Moody, saturated night footage with a noir feel.
title: Neon Rain Crossing

prompt: The lights of a city centre at night hang in the dark as soft, out-of-focus discs of amber and white, slowly sharpening into streets and buildings. The drone drifts sideways high above while the focus pulls in. Warm sodium glow against a black sky, no moon. Abstract, dreamy opening shot for a night sequence.
title: City Lights Bokeh

prompt: White foam swirls and folds across grey-green seawater after a wave has broken, patterns forming and dissolving in constant motion. Vertical frame, the camera points straight down from the air and descends slowly towards the surface. Overcast light keeps the palette cold: slate, pale jade and white. Textural, hypnotic aerial footage.
title: Churning Sea Foam

prompt: A tiny lone hiker climbs a bare scree slope towards a mountain ridge that vanishes into drifting mist. The drone holds far back and rises slowly, keeping the figure small against the mass of the mountain. Pre-dawn light, dusky violet and grey, the fog faintly lit from behind the ridge. Solitary, epic in scale, cinematic.
title: Hiker In The Mist

prompt: A thick bank of cloud rolls across a forested hillside until only one dark edge of treetops is left showing. The camera is fixed on a tripod and the footage is sped up so the fog flows like water. Flat white light, the trees reduced to near-black shapes. Sparse, monochrome and meditative.
title: Fog Swallows The Forest

prompt: Coffee drips from the tip of a clear glass pour-over cone onto a bed of grounds below, each drop catching the light as it falls. Vertical macro shot, the camera locked off and looking up at the curved glass from just beneath it. Bright, even studio light on white surfaces, soft reflections in the glass. Minimal, clean, slow motion.
title: Glass Dripper Close-Up

prompt: Beads of water sit on a sheet of grey glass, a dense cluster of tiny droplets in the centre slowly merging while larger drops slide past. The camera holds a fixed macro view with a thin plane of focus. Diffuse light from behind the pane, silver highlights on a charcoal ground. Abstract and quiet, almost graphic.
title: Droplets On Grey Glass

prompt: A sharp, winding crest divides a great sand dune into a lit side and a shadowed side, with faint tracks running down the slope. The drone flies low along the ridge and banks gently to follow its curve. Low sunset light glows peach on the sand and throws long violet shadows. Sculptural, warm aerial desert footage.
title: Dune Ridge At Sunset

prompt: Broad green ribbons of aurora twist across the night sky above a row of snow-covered timber cabins, their windows lit warm yellow. Locked-off wide shot captured as a time-lapse, the lights sweeping overhead while the cabins stay still. Emerald glow on the snow, a few stars visible. Cosy Arctic night, crisp and clear.
title: Aurora Over Cabins

prompt: The small silhouette of a runner crosses a dark rocky headland above a beach, with waves rolling in below. A long lens holds the figure in a locked-off wide shot against the sky. Thick golden haze at sunrise turns the sea and air the same warm amber, the rocks pure black. Calm, solitary and cinematic.
title: Runner On The Headland

prompt: A moray eel slides out from a crevice and winds across a shallow seabed of pale rock and stubby coral. The camera follows a little above it, gliding forward with a diver's slow movement. Strong sunlight from the surface floods the scene in bright turquoise and ripples across the sand. Clear underwater wildlife footage.
title: Eel Among The Rocks

prompt: Scattered fireworks burst small and bright on the horizon above a sprawling town at night, house lights and lit roads spreading out beneath them. The drone hangs high and pushes forward very slowly. The scene is nearly colourless, white points of light on charcoal black. Distant, hushed, wide aerial footage.
title: Fireworks Over The Town

prompt: Thick snow falls through an old forest, settling on heavy trunks, drooping branches and a fallen log already buried in white. The camera is locked off at eye level among the trees. Dull, even daylight filters through the flakes, the palette reduced to white, grey and brown bark. Silent, still, wintry atmosphere.
title: Deep Winter Woods

prompt: A motorbike follows a narrow road cut into a pale limestone cliff, with open water and low hills on the other side. Vertical rider's-eye view from behind the front of the bike, the camera shaking lightly with the road. Hard midday sun, the sky and water graded to grey while the rock and road stay yellow. Stylised travel footage.
title: Cliff Road Ride

prompt: A tall waterfall drops into a misty jungle clearing, seen past large glossy leaves that hang in the foreground. The camera slides slowly sideways so the leaves move across the frame and reveal the falls. Sunlight flares through the spray from above, greens glowing against white mist. Fresh, humid, cinematic nature shot.
title: Falls Through The Leaves

prompt: A woman carrying a backpack walks away from the camera along a small sandy cove, stepping between dark volcanic rocks at the water's edge. The camera follows at a distance from under overhanging branches. The sun sets behind a line of palms, the wet sand reflecting gold. Easy, warm, holiday-travel footage.
title: Tropical Cove Walk

prompt: Cars queue, turn and pull away at a large road junction at night, their headlights tracing lines across the lanes. The drone hovers overhead at an angle and rotates slowly around the crossing. Yellow sodium street lamps pool on the tarmac while the surrounding blocks fall into black. Steady aerial city footage.
title: Junction After Dark

prompt: Dozens of hot air balloons climb into the sky at once, tiny dots in the distance and big striped envelopes filling the foreground. title: Balloon Festival Launch

prompt: A group of bay horses gallops between leafless trees on a bright green hillside, hooves throwing up turf as they pass. Vertical frame, the camera tracks alongside them at speed in slow motion. Clear midday sun, deep blue sky with scattered white cloud. Energetic, vivid, wild-nature footage.
title: Horses Through The Orchard

prompt: A glowing yellow sign reading HOTEL shines through a rain-covered window, its letters broken up by hundreds of droplets. The camera is locked off inside, focus drifting between the glass and the street beyond. City lights blur into orange and blue discs behind the sign. Lonely late-night mood with a film-noir tone.
title: Hotel Sign In Rain

prompt: Cars stream along a wide city road at night beside an elevated rail line, headlights growing as they come towards the lens. The camera sits low at the roadside and pushes in slowly. Teal light from the viaduct mixes with orange street lamps and the red tip of a distant tower. Sleek, modern, cinematic city footage.
title: Downtown Night Traffic

prompt: A broad wave collapses into a sheet of lacy white foam and spreads across dark green water towards the shore. prompt: An unbroken carpet of conifers covers a steep mountainside, with further ridges fading into blue haze behind it. The drone flies forward low over the treetops and climbs with the slope. title: Evergreen Mountain Flight

prompt: A hill thick with autumn trees rises like an island out of a flat sea of fog, its upper slopes green, rust and gold. The drone orbits slowly at the level of the hilltop. title: Autumn Hill Above Fog

prompt: A thin dark stream of coffee pours into a glossy red cup, the surface rippling as it fills. Extreme close-up from just above the rim, the camera fixed and the handle falling out of focus. Soft golden morning light from behind creates warm round highlights. Inviting, slow-motion breakfast footage.
title: Morning Cup Pour

prompt: Fine raindrops cover a pane of glass and tremble as new ones land, a few growing heavy enough to slide down. title: Storm Glass Texture

prompt: Huge pale sand dunes roll away to a hazy horizon, their knife-edge ridges and scooped hollows repeating into the distance. title: Sea Of Pale Dunes

prompt: A bright green band of aurora stretches low over a calm sea, shimmering above a shoreline of large rounded boulders. Vertical frame, camera fixed on a tripod and recorded as a time-lapse. A thin strip of yellow twilight lingers on the horizon under a dark plum sky. Still, remote, northern night footage.
title: Aurora On The Shore

prompt: A chef in a white jacket and dark apron leans over the counter inside a food truck, assembling a burger and reaching for sauces. title: Food Truck Kitchen

prompt: A runner in full stride crosses a waterfront dock in sharp silhouette, passing a row of mooring bollards. The camera tracks sideways at knee height and keeps pace. The rising sun bursts through heavy cloud behind, edging everything in white light. Bold, high-contrast, motivational sports footage.
title: Dockside Sunrise Sprint

prompt: A bright yellow reef fish with a striped black-and-white face glides past soft purple and pink coral, fins fanning as it turns. Close-up at the fish's level, the camera panning gently to keep it in frame. Cool blue tank light from above, the background softly blurred. Crisp, colourful aquarium footage.
title: Yellow Fish Portrait

prompt: Red fireworks bloom into round bursts one after another, each scattering fine sparks that hang and fade in the dark. The camera is locked off and aimed at the sky with nothing else in view. Crimson light on black, thin smoke drifting between explosions. Simple, festive night footage.
title: Red Bursts At Night

prompt: Snow falls onto a smooth white slope at the edge of a wood where every bush and branch is coated in thick frost. The camera pans slowly left to right at standing height. Bright overcast light makes the whole frame glow white with only thin dark twigs for contrast. Clean, peaceful, wintry scene.
title: Frosted Woodland Edge

prompt: A dark saloon car drives along a two-lane coastal road with rough gravel verges, the grey sea lying flat beyond the edge. Vertical frame, the drone follows from high behind and to one side, keeping the car centred. Soft overcast light and a muted palette of slate, sand and tarmac. Understated automotive footage.
title: Coast Road From Above

prompt: A waterfall fans out over a stepped rock ledge and runs on through a ravine crowded with ferns and broad-leaved plants. The camera holds a steady wide shot from across the stream, with a slight push-in. Shaded daylight, water blurred to white silk, every green in the scene deep and wet. Tranquil rainforest footage.
title: Fern Valley Falls

prompt: Three small figures walk across a wide tidal flat as the sun drops to the horizon. The camera is locked off far back, giving most of the frame to the sky. Heavy grey clouds are lit orange from beneath and the wet sand reflects the last light. Expansive, reflective, golden-hour footage.
title: Low Tide Sundown

prompt: Yellow taxis, buses and crowds of pedestrians pulse through a big city intersection in waves as the signals change. Time-lapse from a high rooftop looking steeply down between glass towers, the camera fixed. Early evening, with lit shop windows and screens brightening as daylight fades. Busy, sharp, metropolitan.
title: Crossroads Time-Lapse

prompt: A white horse and two dark companions trot across a wide open pasture towards a line of trees. The drone trails them from above and behind, staying high enough to show the whole field. Overcast evening light, deep green grass and a band of yellow crops in the distance. Gentle, spacious, pastoral footage.
title: Pasture From The Air

prompt: A band of bright white foam sweeps diagonally over deep blue open water, spreading into fine veins as it thins. Vertical top-down view, the drone holding position while the surf moves beneath it. Strong sun makes the foam dazzle and the water glow sapphire. Fresh, graphic, high-contrast ocean footage.
title: Foam On Deep Blue

prompt: Jagged snow-covered peaks stand above a rocky slope dusted with fresh snow, black rock showing through the white. The drone climbs steadily up the mountainside towards the summit ridge. Sunrise warms the cloud behind the peaks while the snow stays cool blue. Grand, crisp, high-altitude footage.
title: First Light On Peaks

prompt: Fog hangs just above the crowns of a broadleaf forest, slowly sinking until it brushes the treetops. Fixed wide shot from a high lookout, the horizon lost in grey. Weak, even daylight; muted greens under a heavy off-white sky. Hushed and slightly eerie, with a naturalistic look.
title: Canopy Under Low Cloud

prompt: Black coffee pours into a plain white cup that sits on a dark slate table scattered with roasted beans. The camera looks down at an angle and holds steady in close-up. A single soft light from the left leaves the cup gleaming against the shadowed background. Elegant, low-key product footage.
title: White Cup, Dark Table

prompt: Round raindrops stud a window pane, each one holding a tiny upside-down image of the fir tree outside. Vertical macro shot, the camera fixed while drops join and trickle down. Cool daylight after a shower, fresh green against a pale blue-white sky. Clean, calming close-up footage.
title: Green Behind Raindrops

prompt: Smooth folds of pale sand lie beside a flat, wind-swept sheet of desert, with fine grains skimming across the surface. Vertical top-down view, the drone moving slowly forward along the line where the two textures meet. Low sun gives soft cream highlights and gentle grey shadows. Abstract, tactile and calm.
title: Soft Sand Ripples

prompt: Curtains of green aurora topped with deep red sweep across the whole sky above a flat, dark horizon. Wide locked-off time-lapse, the bands rippling and re-forming in seconds. No moon; the land is a thin black strip beneath the colour. Dramatic, immersive night-sky footage.
title: Red And Green Aurora

prompt: A steel ladle stirs and lifts a tangle of fried noodles with egg and vegetables in a wide wok over a gas burner, steam rising off the pan. Vertical overhead shot, the camera held steady directly above the stove. Plain kitchen light, the food golden against dark metal. Honest, close-up home-cooking footage.
title: Wok Noodle Toss

prompt: Two distant joggers run along the wet edge of a beach as low waves break beside them. A long lens compresses the scene in a locked-off wide shot from the far end of the bay. Dense golden sunrise haze erases the horizon and leaves figures and rocks as silhouettes. Soft, warm, contemplative.
title: Shoreline Joggers

prompt: A small silver-blue fish with dark fins hovers and darts above a bed of coral that lies blurred in the foreground. The camera follows it in a slow sideways pan through open water. Dim blue light from above, particles drifting in the beam. Quiet, deep-toned underwater footage.
title: Small Fish, Blue Water

prompt: Thick pillows of snow rest on thin twigs in the foreground while fresh flakes drift down past them. The camera holds a close-up with shallow focus, the forest behind dissolved into white. Soft daylight with a faint blue cast, dark stems the only detail. Delicate, quiet winter macro.
title: Snow-Laden Twigs

prompt: Two slender waterfalls drop down a tall cliff completely covered in vines and ferns, with smaller streams spilling beside them. The camera tilts up slowly from the base of the gorge to the lip of the falls. Light filters in from the open sky above, leaving the lower walls in deep green shade. Majestic jungle footage.
title: Twin Falls Gorge

prompt: A red sun sinks towards a calm sea and lays a narrow column of light across the water to the sand. Vertical frame, camera locked off on the beach with a palm frond hanging into the left of the shot. Sky fading from coral to dusty violet, wavelets barely moving. Tranquil holiday-evening footage.
title: Red Sun, Still Sea

prompt: Vans and cars smear into red and white light trails along a broad tree-lined avenue while the traffic signals flick between green and red. Fixed time-lapse from the central reservation at street level. Rows of old-style street lamps recede under a black sky. Urban, restless, long-exposure look.
title: Boulevard Light Trails

prompt: A few horses run across rough open grassland, small against the expanse of the field and the woods behind it. The drone approaches from high above and descends gradually towards them. Flat grey sky, grass in dull green and straw tones. Understated, observational aerial footage.
title: Horses Far Below

prompt: A city spreads to the horizon at night, its roads and districts picked out as thousands of white points on black. The drone glides forward high above in a smooth, slow move. Shot in black and white with deep contrast and no sky detail. Stark, elegant, title-sequence style.
title: Monochrome City Lights

prompt: Dark teal water boils with white foam, swirling in tight eddies as swell after swell passes through. The camera looks straight down and rotates very slowly above the surface. Cold, flat light with no reflections, foam like marble veins. Powerful, abstract, moody ocean footage.
title: Dark Water Turbulence

prompt: Cloud pours over a mountain summit and streams down the far side, breaking now and then to show patches of snow and a mast on the peak. Locked-off time-lapse from a neighbouring ridge. Shafts of sun pierce a heavy sky and light the top of the cloud. Dramatic, fast-moving weather footage.
title: Summit Cloud Rush

prompt: A veil of mist drifts up a wooded slope and slips between trees in green, amber and russet. Vertical aerial shot, the drone moving slowly backwards and upward to reveal more forest. Soft early light, warm on the canopy and milky in the fog. Gentle seasonal footage with a painterly look.
title: Mist Through Autumn Trees

prompt: Amber-brown coffee runs from the lip of a glass server in a fine, steady stream into a pale ceramic cup. Vertical close-up, the camera fixed and focused on the falling liquid. Light from behind makes the coffee glow translucent against a white wall. Refined, minimal, slow-motion cafe footage.
title: Glass Server Pour

prompt: Light rain speckles a window while the blocks of flats across the street stay blurred into grey rectangles. The camera is locked off indoors and the focus breathes slowly from the drops to the buildings and back. Dull afternoon light, desaturated and soft. Pensive, stay-at-home mood.
title: City Behind The Rain

prompt: A narrow dune crest snakes ahead, its sides ribbed with fine wind ripples and falling away steeply on both sides. Vertical point-of-view shot, the camera moving forward along the ridge at walking pace. Late sun turns the sand deep orange under a pale, dusty sky. Immersive, warm, adventure-travel feel.
title: Walking The Dune Crest

prompt: Streaks of teal aurora arc across a starry sky above a small harbour, where a lit pier and red waterfront buildings reflect in the water. Wide shot from the opposite shore, camera fixed, recorded as a time-lapse. Cold cyan sky against warm lamps along the quay. Clear, magical winter night.
title: Harbour Under Aurora

prompt: A man in a white hooded top and black shorts jogs away down a gravel path between clipped hedges and overhanging trees. The camera follows directly behind at chest height on a stabiliser. Mild, hazy morning light with fresh spring greens. Simple, natural everyday fitness footage.
title: Park Path Jog

prompt: A large blue fish cruises through the middle of a reef tank while smaller fish circle above fans and stacks of coral. The camera pans slowly across the scene from left to right. The whole frame is saturated in electric blue light with pale coral shapes. Bright, bold aquarium footage.
title: Blue Tank Residents

prompt: A firework opens into a white starburst above a grid of city streets where parked cars and lit windows line a long avenue. The drone hovers high and tilts down slowly from the burst to the road. Black-and-white footage, grainy and dark. Distant, atmospheric, night aerial.
title: Firework Over Streets

prompt: Snow drifts through a stand of slim trees, seen from behind a rough trunk that fills the left edge of the frame. The camera slides slowly out from behind the bark to open up the view. Cold blue-grey dusk light, the forest floor white. Intimate, still, cinematic winter shot.
title: Snowfall Past The Trunk

prompt: A 4x4 drives along a broad strip of white sand between lines of pale green surf and low scrub. The drone looks down from high up and follows, the vehicle only a speck. Bright, hazy midday light flattens the sand to chalk white. Remote, spacious, coastal-expedition footage.
title: Long Empty Beach

prompt: Water streams over dark boulders at the top of a rainforest slope while big rain-beaded leaves shine in the foreground. Vertical frame, the camera tilting up from the leaves to the waterfall. Dim green light under the canopy with bright sky at the very top. Close, damp, immersive nature footage.
title: Wet Leaves And Falls

prompt: A bare foot steps forward onto soft beach sand already covered in footprints, grains shifting under the toes. title: Barefoot In Sand

prompt: Headlights flow in an unbroken ribbon along a curving avenue between apartment towers as the city lights come on. Time-lapse from a fixed high viewpoint over the rooftops. title: Blue Hour Avenue

prompt: A hot air balloon patterned in orange and teal squares lifts off just above the treetops, its burner firing and the wicker basket swinging gently. The camera tilts up from the ground to follow it. Clear morning light and a soft blue sky with thin cloud. Bright, uplifting, simple footage.
title: Checkered Balloon Rising

prompt: A herd of dark and bay horses gallops across a wide green meadow, manes flying as they bunch together and stretch out. The camera tracks alongside them from a distance in slow motion. Overcast light, rich grass and misty hills beyond. Free, powerful, nature-documentary style.
title: Herd At Full Gallop

prompt: Low mist skims across the surface of a mountain lake as the sun clears a dark wooded ridge and throws a bright path over the water. title: Misty Lake Sunrise

prompt: A fast, clear river tumbles over stones and around one huge pale boulder, its banks crowded with bushes and tall leafy trees. title: River Through The Valley

prompt: A heavy swell slams into a slab of sloping rock and explodes upward in a wall of spray, then drains back in white streams before the next wave hits. title: Surf Against The Rocks

prompt: Three chestnut horses graze along the edge of an eroded bank on a hillside of tall dry grass, lifting their heads now and then to look around. title: Horses On Dry Hillside

prompt: A burst of orange sparks whirls up from a fire burning in a metal bowl, scattering across the dark towards a full moon overhead. Elemental and hypnotic.
title: Sparks Under The Moon

prompt: A sharp snow-covered peak stands above dark forested slopes, with patches of old snow lying on the grassy ridge in the foreground. title: Snow Peak Reveal

prompt: A narrow path covered in fallen leaves winds between tall straight trunks, with a few leaves still dropping from the canopy. title: Autumn Forest Trail

prompt: Rows of lavender bend and spring back in a steady breeze, the purple flower heads moving in waves beside a strip of mown grass. title: Lavender In The Wind

prompt: A sea turtle glides low over a wide coral reef, paddling with slow sweeps of its front flippers while small fish scatter ahead of it. title: Turtle Over The Reef

prompt: A dark river cuts between snow-covered banks and frosted forest, with a few evergreens standing out green against the white. The camera points straight down from the air and travels slowly along the course of the water. Flat winter daylight, black water and white snow in strong contrast. Graphic, silent aerial footage.
title: Winter River From Above

prompt: A small herd of horses wades across a shallow river in single file, their reflections breaking up in the ripples around their legs.
